baseline.answer:
Hello,

To request a Jira licence, please provide the following information:

- **User type:** Internal or External User
- **User requiring the licence:** Full name (and employee ID, if internal)
- **Application:** Jira
- **Project engagement:** Project name or engagement code
- **Jira project:** Project key and/or a link to an issue in the project
- **Justification:** Please confirm that access is required to view your tasks for the **CASSA CENTRALE** project

The Jira project key is the prefix in an issue identifier, formatted as `<Project_Key>-<number>`. You can find it in any Jira issue URL or Jira email notification. Please note that the Jira Service Management portal URL is not a valid project URL.

Once this information is provided, we can process the licence request.

query_description: Il tuo PC risulta obsoleto e fuori garanzia. Ti cambieremo il vecchio PC Service TAG 4HMTL81 con uno nuovo. Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG 8LQG528 Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Milano. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1)Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2)Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali https://short.url/policy - Guide IT [help.gft.com](https://short.url/guides) L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG 4HMTL81 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG 8LQG528 We will send you the new PC to the Milan office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. baseline.answer:
Hello,

If this is only for installing a new Node.js version, please submit the request through **Windows Software Installation – I need software or a license installed on my computer**, rather than requesting permanent administrator rights.

If you require administrator rights for recurring development tasks, please provide the following information so the appropriate Local Admin Rights request can be assessed:

- Whether the rights are needed temporarily or long term, and why recurring access is required
- Full name of your GHT manager or approver at level L6 or above
- Computer name (Device Name in Company Portal or the result of `hostname`)
- Operating system
- Client/project name
- Detailed justification, including the Node.js-related actions requiring elevation

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with the Intesa project or client requirements. Permanent rights require proper justification and approval, and approved access must be renewed after 12 months.

Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GDT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Luca Bianchi (Torino) (H37K)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GDT-aWmEc4stui9 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GDT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Braniff Projects
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
ivanti, npm, other tools
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GDT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GDT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GDT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GDT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GDT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GDT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GDT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GDT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GDT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- General Instructions:

- Computer name information:

- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFB & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Intesa San Paolo
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need the admin rights to:
- edit environment variables needed by the projects
- install new developer tools
- update existing developer tools
- update client tools
- install client certificates

- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFB Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFB Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFB Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFB Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFB Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFB Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFB Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFB Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFB/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base IT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the IT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from IT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of IT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:

reference_reply:
Please note that this request requires additional information to proceed with.

The easiest way to provide the information is to open a new request from the portal using the following link:

[Corporate computers - * I need administrator rights on my computer >>](shortlink/example)

Also, you can provide needed information in this ticket:

Note: If you don't provide this information, ticket will be closed after five working days.

General Instructions:

Please provide the full name of a Project Manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If your current level is L6 or above, the approver is not required. Therefore, please add your own name to the approver field.

1) Project Manager L6 or above:

2) Computer Name or other Name:

3) Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?

No | Yes ( Please use the following subcategory: "I need software or a license installed on my computer")

Additional information

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, XYZ Corp & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.

4) List clients and projects you work on:

5) Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:

6) Agree to XYZ Corp Local Admin Rights Policy by following this url: [XYZ Corp Local Admin Rights Policy](shortlink/example)

Important Information

The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.

7) Please confirm you Agreed (Yes, I have read carefully and understood the concepts. I agree to follow it. / No, I haven't read it.):

Best regards,
Group IT.

Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GDT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Giovanni Russo (Roma) (B75D)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GDT-RjnoFleWERa (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GDT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demand us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Banque BNP Paribas
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need to install the following programs: SecureConnect, OpenJDK, Eclipse, Postman, certificate BNP repository
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed 12 months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GDT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GDT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GDT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GDT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GDT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To request Microsoft Project, please submit the **“Extra information needed to request a software or a licence on my Windows device”** form and provide:

- Confirmation that you accept the software-installation security information and responsibilities
- A business justification, including your collaboration with Nexi project managers

- Software: **Microsoft Project**
- License type: **Pay per license**
- Project engagement and project element
- Whether installation support is required

Please ensure the software is obtained from a trustworthy source and kept updated with the latest security patches. In case of suspicious activity, report it to **databreach@example.com**.

retrieval.title: I need to create a new team on MS Teams
retrieval.reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to create or rename a new Team in MS Teams
- Important information:
Please, to create your primary business project Team, please use the “Project Portal”: https://shorturl.com/projectportal

For any request of an additional Team, e.g. for Guest Collaboration with clients, please use this iTop category
- Select the team scope: Global / Local / Group: Italy
- Client or Internal Department?: Client
- Please, specify which is your Client or Internal Department: Allianz
- Project (please leave empty if not applicable):
- Team (please leave empty if not applicable):
- Requested for: Business
- Data Protection important information:
Personal Data means any information relating to a natural person which can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identifier such as a name, an identification number, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person.
Please answer “YES” here, if you expect any storage of Personal Data beyond the one which takes place by the system by default (like username and password).
For example: a custom list of all team members with their private contact details, a custom document library with photos of a team event, a custom list of client contacts and their special interests and hobbies, a document library with the development plans and annual achievements of some employees, etc.
- Data Protection: is storage of personal data expected?: No
- Will client confidential data (e.g. production data ) processed and stored in this team?: No
- Is it expected to share the team or parts of it with externals? (Externals are customers and partners without GFT-ID. Contractors with e-account (e-...@gft.com) are no externals): No
- Team classification information:
RESTRICTED
Description: Data not commonly available to outside user. Guests as a member in a team are not allowed.
Use case: Internal GFT community teams, projects, CS department teams (e.g. HR dep), Software development deliverables, e.g. source code, requirements, functional designs, technical designs, knowledge management, meeting minutes, etc.

RESTRICTED GST
Description: External sharing and collaboration in a Team, no confidential data. Use this team only for content that has to be shared with the guests. For other content not to be shared use a separate Team with classification No Guests.
Use case: Collaboration with a provider. Non-confidential client information

CONFIDENTIAL
Description: No external sharing available.
Use case: All - HOD team (not all to GFT), GMB meeting data, Trade secrets, strategic plans and presentations

CONFIDENTIAL GST
Description: Critical data only available to a limited set of people inside and outside of the organization. Use this team only for content that has to be shared with the guests. For other content not to be shared use a separate Team with classification No Guests. Sharing needs owner approval.
Use case: Mergers and acquisitions, projects with external consultants
- Classification of the team: Restricted
- Guest On-boarding Important Information::
To invite Guests to GFT´s Modern Workplace environment, you need to be a team or a SharePoint Online Guest classified site Owner.
Please find the complete process for guest user invitation here:

https://shorturl.com/addgueststeam

Important Information:

Please be aware that new guest accounts which did not accept the invite to a GFT Guest Team in a period of 28 days will be deleted from the GFT’s infrastructure.
Please inform your potential new guest about this period. A new service request will be required again to invite such guests.
- Approval instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L5 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.
NOTE: If you are L5 and above, you don't need a manager review. Therefore please add your own name as the Manager.
- L5 or above Manager name: Alessandro Bianchi (Rome) (ZJOL)
- Additional Responsible Team Owner (the requestor is added as a Team Owner by default). Please add her/him as a contact.: Carlo Moretti (Rome) (B29M)

- Computer name information:

- Computer Name: GFT-XyTWghkp1zE (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
BPER
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Intellij, jasper studio, build maven
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/IT Infrastructure Department
